identity.business: Detroit-based fintech / homeownership platform: Rocket Mortgage (largest US mortgage lender), Mr. Cooper (largest US mortgage servicer, acquired late 2025), Redfin (online real estate brokerage/home search, acquired 2025), Rocket Home Equity (largest US home equity lender), Rocket Loans (personal loans), Rocket Money (fintech subscriptions app), Rocket Homes, title/closing services. Integrates search (Redfin) -> mortgage -> servicing -> recapture -> adjacent products (home equity, personal loans). Largest US mortgage lender AND servicer.
identity.founder_chairman: Dan Gilbert (control ~62% voting stake via Class L)
identity.capital_structure: Collapsed up-C structure in 2025 (four classes -> two: Class A + Class L), unified voting to one-vote-per-share, issued $0.80 special cash dividend to Class A holders, created Class L with 79% voting cap for Dan Gilbert. Share-count jump from ~147M (FY24, Class A only) to ~2.83B is this recapitalization reflecting full economic ownership, NOT real shareholder dilution. ~2.83B shares = correct count for per-share valuation.

q2_2026.quote: Record market share and most profitable quarter in four years; >70% of revenue recurring or less rate-sensitive; strongest quarter in recent memory despite tough market

key_questions_for_lenses: Valuation model convention: RKT's GAAP 'net debt' (-$29.7B) is dominated by warehouse/MSR financing matched to assets; management frames net corporate leverage at 0.9x EBITDA. Damodaran/FCFF models must pick an economic net-debt convention and disclose it.
Share count 2.83B reflects the 2025 recap (full economic ownership), not dilution. Use 2.83B for per-share value.
Negative TTM FCF (-$772M) and volatile GAAP margins (op margin 20% TTM but net margin 4.6%) require normalization; servicing provides a ~$1B/qtr stable cash-flow floor per mgmt.
Forward PE 20.2x vs trailing 81.9x — analysts price the normalized earnings power (~$441M adj NI in one quarter = ~$1.8B annualized adj NI).
High rate cycle (30-yr ~6.8%) is compressing volumes; Q3 guide implies revenue QoQ decline; market-share gains (purchase 6.2%, refi 14.3%) are the offsetting engine.
